summary: For each prefix length from zero through n-1, move that prefix to the end of the string. Count rotation positions whose resulting linear string has exactly k equal neighboring character pairs. Only pairs at indices i and i+1 for i<n-1 contribute.
officialConstraints: Lowercase English string of length 2..100; 0 <= k <= n-1.
semanticPitfalls: Count rotation positions, even when resulting texts coincide. Do not count the last/first characters as a linear adjacent pair.
title: Count Rotations With Exactly K Equal Adjacent Pairs
